title: Purina Fancy Feast Grilled Wet Cat Food Seafood Collection in Wet Cat Food Variety Pack - (Pack of 24) 3 oz. Cans

reviews.title: Best choice
reviews.body: I have to cat's,  I like to call them my cubs and I'm there papa. They do not like the traditional pate at all, so I looked for quite a whe until I found the right gravy mix for them. They have tried a few different varieties,  and they love sea food the best.  They can't get enough of it. Thank you for a great choice as far as price, quantity, and I can not verify for myself but taste as well  😀. Thank you, from a Veteran: Rodney A Foster
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 7, 2026
reviews.author: Rodney A Foster

reviews.title: CAT HEAVEN!!!
reviews.body: I have what used to be a very picky cat. There have been long term feeding problems because he contracted feline HIV and had half his teeth pulled so only his canines remain in front and he tends to licks up most of his food and only eat a small amount at one time. I just fed him a 3 ounce can of this grilled cat food which he rapidly and continuously devoured with great relish until nothing was left. AI tells me this is a well balanced cat food with everything he needs. So both cat and I are very happy. Price is quite reasonable, especially since I live in Hawaii where they don't stock this in stores and everything is hyper expensive. Cat lovers know the value of having a food your cat loves.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 2, 2026
reviews.author: A. Hoffman

reviews.title: My cat goes crazy for this — great variety and quality
reviews.body: This Fancy Feast Grilled Seafood variety pack has been a huge hit with my cat. Every time I open a can, she comes running. The grilled texture is soft and easy for her to eat, and the seafood flavors give her plenty of variety so she doesn’t get bored.I really like that the portions are just right for a single meal and that the food looks and smells fresh (as far as cat food goes). It’s been great for keeping her hydrated since it’s wet food, and her appetite has been consistently strong since switching to this pack.Overall, this is an excellent variety pack — convenient, good quality, and most importantly, completely cat-approved. I’ll definitely keep repurchasing.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 17, 2026
reviews.author: Lena Wilt

reviews.title: Happy cat = happy household
reviews.body: My cat is overweight, we got fat shamed by a vet who attempted to force some very expensive prescription diet food on us. Knowing that my cat looks for exactly two things in food - that it is seafood and it is pate - I knew that the prescription stuff was going to be a waste of money. Long story short we saw another vet, she explained he's only a LITTLE overweight for his overall size and the best non-prescription food (or as good as in many cases) is the fancy feast classic pate collection, which was a huge relief as at the time that was the only food Fred would eat.PROS- It is very cost effective!- It has limited calories and has done really well helping my dude maintain his weight- He loves ALMOST all the flavours- Multiple vets have recommended this particular product over far more expensive brandsCONS- He sometimes won't eat the salmon, which is a bit wasteful as it goes to the stray cats or the dog. but thats entirely a him and me problem.- its pretty pungent (a me problem, cats love pungent food)- its sometimes hard to get the bigger value packs as they don't seem to stay in stock all the timeHot tip- if your cat enjoys this food get the purina app and enter your receipts to get points and they'll send you free samples of new products, vouchers and you can cash in the points for cool things- like a lid to stop the cat food from stinking out your office.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 23, 2026
reviews.author: Douglas

reviews.title: Great food got my older cat eating again
reviews.body: My older cat (18) loves this food. He can be picky about some but begs for more with this kind. He has been eating more recently since switching as his weight has been slowly going down the past few years. He does have grain allergies and this food has not caused issues.
